jobs.title: DMO
jobs.description:
**Urgent Hiring!!!!!!!!!!**  
**Preferred location: Vellore, Tamil nadu**

**Job Description:**

The DMO will assist in patient care, coordinate with other healthcare professionals, and handle emergencies, ensuring the safety and well\-being of patients. The role involves both clinical and administrative duties, aimed at supporting the daily operations of the IVF facility.

**Patient Care:**

* Monitor patients undergoing IVF treatments, ensuring they receive appropriate care.
* Perform routine check\-ups, monitor vitals, and assess patient progress.
* Address patient concerns and answer queries related to IVF treatments.

**Coordination and Communication:**

* Coordinate with fertility specialists, nurses, and lab technicians to ensure a smooth workflow.
* Facilitate communication between patients and doctors, ensuring patient concerns are addressed promptly.
* Assist in the planning and scheduling of patient procedures and follow\-up visits.

**Assistance in Procedures:**

* Assist senior doctors during IVF procedures such as egg retrieval, embryo transfer, and other related treatments.
* Prepare and sterilize instruments and ensure all equipment is ready for use.

**Administrative Duties:**

* Oversee the maintenance of patient files, ensuring all documentation is complete and accurate.
* Assist in managing patient appointments and the flow of patients through the clinic.
* Participate in regular meetings and contribute to the improvement of patient care services.

**uality Assurance and Compliance:**

* Ensure adherence to hospital protocols and standards.
* Maintain compliance with regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Participate in regular training and updates on IVF treatment protocols and patient care standards.

**Qualifications:**

* MBBS degree from a recognized medical college or university.
* Valid medical license to practice in the state.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Strong clinical and diagnostic skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Compassionate and empathetic attitude towards patients.

Location : Vellore

Experience : Fresher to 1 year

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher
